title: Word Weaver
description: A five-letter deduction word game with a seeded Daily puzzle, endless Unlimited play and an escalating eight-stage Gauntlet. Nearly 1,900 answers and a 3,700-word guess dictionary are embedded in the game — no network required. Hard mode, colour-blind palette, on-screen and physical keyboard, and a full share-free stats panel with streaks and guess distribution.
